summary: Northern end of the east kerb where cars park; homes 11-12 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 11-12 m away on same side

best_section.where: East kerb near the northern end, past the construction block, before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11-12 m away on the east side and about 20 m across the road; no bush buffer here.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the east kerb, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; No Parking 9am-5pm weekdays signed, No Stopping Any Time signs elsewhere on the stretch.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on both sides
No Parking 9am-5pm Mon-Fri signs on this kerb
Earlier parts of the stretch have homes 2-5 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Street trees give partial shade over the east kerb from the east and midday; afternoon sun from the west.
